description: Every resource in the GCP root's declared state exists in the environment

ci_plan_exclusions.reason: The GCP budget lives on the billing account, which without an organization accepts only predefined roles, and CNA-DFP bars predefined roles on workload identities. The read-only collector cannot read it, so CI's plan leaves it out; local runs as terraform-admin cover it (DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-01).
